        uses: microsoft/onnxruntime-github-actions/setup-build-tools@v0.0.8

          cmake-version: 3.28.3
          vcpkg-version: 2024.04.26
          vcpkg-hash: 1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef12345678 # Placeholder hash, usually derived from version
          add-cmake-to-path: true

      - name: Install Dependencies via vcpkg
        run: |
          ./vcpkg/vcpkg install glog protobuf libpcap nlohmann-json --triplet x64-linux
          # Note: Adjust package names based on actual pkt2flow dependencies

      - name: Configure CMake
        run: |
          cmake -B build -S . \
            -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=${{ matrix.build-type }} \
            -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=${{ env.VCPKG_INSTALLATION_ROOT }}/scripts/buildsystems/vcpkg.cmake \
            -DBUILD_TESTING=ON

      - name: Build
        run: cmake --build build --config ${{ matrix.build-type }} --parallel $(nproc)

      - name: Run Unit Tests
        run: |
          cd build
          ctest --output-on-failure --parallel $(nproc)

      - name: Upload Test Results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: test-results-${{ matrix.build-type }}
          path: build/Testing/Temporary/LastTest.log
